text: It is also known as Sambal Tina or Tina Sambal, and has dialects in other parts of Zambales like Santa Cruz, Masinloc, and Iba. Speakers of Sambal have 70% intelligibility with Botolan [sbl] (Eberhard et al., 2022), and Sambal has many cognates in Bolinao [smk] (Stone, 2006).

title: Sambal, Botolan Language (SBL) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status ...
text: Botolan Sambal is a stable indigenous language of the Philippines. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is used as a language of instruction in some schools.
